summary: Growing Austin freight company with a broken quote link and no online tracking; competitors offer both.

findings.title: Broken 'Get a Quote' link
findings.business_impact: Visitors who want a quote hit a dead end, so leads are lost.
findings.our_solution: Fix the link and add a proper quote form that emails the team and logs the lead.

findings.title: No online shipment tracking
findings.evidence: No tracking or customer login found on the site
findings.business_impact: Customers call the office for updates, which costs staff time.
findings.our_solution: Customer portal with live load status.

findings.title: Competitors offer online quotes and tracking
findings.evidence: FastFreight and ShipRight both show tracking pages
findings.business_impact: Shoppers comparing carriers may pick the one that is easier online.
findings.our_solution: Quote + tracking portal; optional AI assistant for quote questions.

messages.email_body:
Hi Sarah,

I spent some time on acmelogistics.com this morning. The Get a Quote link on your homepage leads to a page that no longer exists, so anyone trying to request a quote hits a dead end. I also spotted a couple of other things that could bring in more bookings.

I've put together a free 1-page review with ideas for each. Want me to send it over?
messages.whatsapp: Hi Sarah, I was looking at acmelogistics.com and noticed the Get a Quote link goes to a missing page, so quote requests may be getting lost. I wrote up a free 1-page review with a few ideas. Want me to send it?
messages.report_delivery: Hi Sarah, here's the 1-page review of acmelogistics.com I mentioned. The quick win is the broken quote link; the bigger opportunity is online load tracking. If it's useful, I'd be glad to walk you through it on a 15-minute call. We can talk through scope and timing on a call or at our next meeting, and we'll plan it around your budget.
messages.followup_1: Hi Sarah, one more thing from my review: customers can't track a shipment on your site, which usually means extra calls to your team. Still happy to send the full 1-page review if it helps.
messages.followup_2: Hi Sarah, FastFreight and ShipRight both let customers request quotes and track loads online. An AI assistant could also answer common quote questions around the clock. Worth a quick look?
